title: Microsoft Corporation — Company Profile
author: MarketLine
use: Company overview and SWOT format example.

author: Michael E. Porter; Harvard Business Review
use: Foundational supplied article on competitive forces and industry profit potential.

author: Alex Walton and Charley Gale; Competitive Intelligence Alliance

title: What is competitive intelligence? / Competitive Intelligence: What It Is and How to Do It
author: Alex Walton; Competitive Intelligence Alliance
use: Practical introduction connecting competitor research, customer needs, and business decisions.
limitations: Practitioner/vendor context; assess tool and outcome claims independently.

author: Dylan Matthews; Vox
use: Profile of INR expertise, institutional memory, and dissent.
limitations: Selected journalistic account, not an audited forecasting record; avoid repeating accuracy superlatives as measured fact.

author: W. Chan Kim and Renée Mauborgne; Harvard Business Review Press
use: Full supplied expanded-edition text with strategy canvas, four actions, six paths, noncustomers, sequence, and execution.
